import Std

/-! Exact autonomous exterior map for the decimal complementary-band quotient.
The ordinary reverse-and-add bridge is a separate written proof. -/
namespace P196.Agent6

abbrev Word := List Nat

/-- Normalize a finite coefficient word with a specified incoming carry. -/
def norm : Word → Nat → Word × Nat
  | [], e => ([], e)
  | x :: xs, e =>
      let rest := norm xs ((x + e) / 10)
      ((x + e) % 10 :: rest.1, rest.2)

structure Exterior where
  phase : Nat
  word : Word
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Delete the homogeneous phase suffix, leaving the canonical interface. -/
def trim (c : Nat) (w : Word) : Word :=
  (w.reverse.dropWhile (fun x => x == c)).reverse

/-- The actual overflow is computed, not independently selected. -/
def advance (s : Exterior) : Exterior :=
  let c := s.phase
  let k := if 10 ≤ c then 1 else 0
  let t := c - 9 * k
  let left := norm s.word 0
  let right := norm s.word.reverse k
  let u := c + left.2 - 10 * k
  let rhs := if right.2 == 0 then right.1.reverse ++ [t]
             else 1 :: right.1.reverse
  let raw := List.zipWith Nat.add (left.1 ++ [u]) rhs
  ⟨2 * t, trim (2 * t) raw⟩

def iterate : Nat → Exterior → Exterior
  | 0, s => s
  | n + 1, s => iterate n (advance s)

/-- True exactly when the exterior exceeds the cap at some time at most n. -/
def escapes (cap : Nat) : Nat → Exterior → Bool
  | 0, s => decide (cap < s.word.length)
  | n + 1, s => if cap < s.word.length then true else escapes cap n (advance s)

theorem escapes_sound (cap n : Nat) (s : Exterior)
    (h : escapes cap n s = true) :
    ∃ t, t ≤ n ∧ cap < (iterate t s).word.length := by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero =>
      have hs : cap < s.word.length := by simpa [escapes] using h
      exact ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 0, hs⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hs : cap < s.word.length
      · exact ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, hs⟩
      · have hn : escapes cap n (advance s) = true := by
          simpa [escapes, hs] using h
        obtain ⟨t, ht, hw⟩ := ih (advance s) hn
        exact ⟨t + 1, Nat.succ_le_succ ht, hw⟩

/-- Fixed-width base-19 digits, least significant first. -/
def digits19 : Nat → Nat → Word
  | 0, _ => []
  | n + 1, z => z % 19 :: digits19 n (z / 19)

/-- All periodic phases, positive first coefficient, then `tailWidth` digits.
Canonical trimming gives a bijection with exteriors of length <=tailWidth+1. -/
def decode (tailWidth phaseIndex firstIndex tailCode : Nat) : Exterior :=
  let c := 2 * (phaseIndex + 1)
  ⟨c, trim c ((firstIndex + 1) :: digits19 tailWidth tailCode)⟩

def checkChunk (tailWidth bound phaseIndex firstIndex : Nat) : Bool :=
  (List.range (19 ^ tailWidth)).all fun z =>
    escapes (tailWidth + 1) bound (decode tailWidth phaseIndex firstIndex z)

theorem checkChunk_sound (tailWidth bound phaseIndex firstIndex z : Nat)
    (hz : z < 19 ^ tailWidth)
    (h : checkChunk tailWidth bound phaseIndex firstIndex = true) :
    ∃ t, t ≤ bound ∧ tailWidth + 1 <
      (iterate t (decode tailWidth phaseIndex firstIndex z)).word.length := by
  apply escapes_sound
  exact List.all_eq_true.mp h z (List.mem_range.mpr hz)

#print axioms escapes_sound
#print axioms checkChunk_sound

end P196.Agent6

This source is OUTSIDE every accepted Lean build. No axioms/admissions/unsafe.

namespace Agent110.TwoStepBoundary

def firstLast (mu x a : Nat) : Nat :=
  if mu == 0 then 12 + (x + a) / 10
  else 6 + (x + a) / 10 + x % 10

def firstPenultPossible (mu x a want : Nat) : Bool :=
  if mu == 0 then decide (want = (x + a) % 10 + x % 10)
  else decide ((x + a) % 10 ≤ want ∧ want ≤ (x + a) % 10 + 9)

def secondLast (nu w b : Nat) : Nat :=
  if nu == 0 then 5 + (w + b) / 10
  else 2 + (w + b) / 10 + (w + 1) % 10

def secondPenultPossible (nu w b want : Nat) : Bool :=
  if nu == 0 then decide (want = (w + b) % 10 + (w + 1) % 10)
  else decide ((w + b) % 10 ≤ want ∧ want ≤ (w + b) % 10 + 9)

/-- q = first trim count; 2-q = second trim count; mu/nu overflow bits.
x is original terminal coefficient; w first-step surviving terminal coefficient.
The free reflected digits are allowed their full 0..9 range (overapprox). -/
def boundaryCandidate (q mu nu x a b w : Nat) : Bool :=
  (x != 6) &&
  (let L := firstLast mu x a
   if q == 0 then L != 12 && w == L
   else if q == 1 then
     L == 12 && w != 12 && firstPenultPossible mu x a w
   else
     L == 12 && firstPenultPossible mu x a 12 && w != 12) &&
  (let L := secondLast nu w b
   if q == 0 then L == 6 && secondPenultPossible nu w b 6
   else if q == 1 then L == 6 && secondPenultPossible nu w b x
   else L == x)

/-- Full finite search over necessary terminal-boundary parameters only.
No width cap is encoded, but the missing source-to-boundary theorem matters. -/
def anyBoundaryCandidate : Bool :=
  (List.range 3).any fun q =>
    (List.range 2).any fun mu =>
      (List.range 2).any fun nu =>
        (List.range 19).any fun x =>
          (List.range 2).any fun a =>
            (List.range 2).any fun b =>
              (List.range 19).any fun w =>
                boundaryCandidate q mu nu x a b w

/-- WIP: candidate kernel-reduction check; awaiting official Lean 4.19.0.
Do not label LEAN-CHECKED before compiling under the actual dependency pins. -/
theorem no_abstract_two_step_boundary : anyBoundaryCandidate = false := by
  decide

#print axioms no_abstract_two_step_boundary

/-!
MISSING FORMAL BRIDGES:
1. For canonical phase6 words of length >=2, exact norm/trim and
   the two-step state equality imply q+secondTrim=2.
2. Extract bounded x, w, carry bits a,b and overflow bits mu,nu,

3. Handle empty and singleton source words by the exact source semantics.
4. Import this self-contained arithmetic result into the ORIGINAL

/-! Agent #110: exact carry interface for original P196.Agent6.norm.
Proposed source-bridge layer; no all-width nonreturn theorem claimed. -/
namespace Agent110.TwoStepNorm
open P196.Agent6

theorem norm_snoc (xs : Word) (x e : Nat) :
    norm (xs ++ [x]) e =
      ((norm xs e).1 ++ [(x + (norm xs e).2) % 10],
       (x + (norm xs e).2) / 10) := by
  induction xs generalizing e with
  | nil => simp [norm]
  | cons y ys ih => simp [norm, ih]

theorem norm_digits_length (xs : Word) (e : Nat) :
    (norm xs e).1.length = xs.length := by
  induction xs generalizing e with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp [norm, ih]

theorem norm_terminal_digit (xs : Word) (x e : Nat) :
    (norm (xs ++ [x]) e).1.getLast? =
      some ((x + (norm xs e).2) % 10) := by
  rw [norm_snoc]
  simp

theorem norm_terminal_carry (xs : Word) (x e : Nat) :
    (norm (xs ++ [x]) e).2 =
      (x + (norm xs e).2) / 10 := by
  rw [norm_snoc]

#print axioms norm_snoc
#print axioms norm_digits_length
#print axioms norm_terminal_digit
#print axioms norm_terminal_carry
end Agent110.TwoStepNorm

/-! Generic last-column preservation for original exterior raw zipWith Nat.add.
This is a bridge lemma, not an all-length cycle theorem. -/
namespace Agent110.TwoStepZip
open P196.Agent6

theorem zipWith_add_snoc (xs ys : Word) (x y : Nat)
    (hlen : xs.length = ys.length) :
    List.zipWith Nat.add (xs ++ [x]) (ys ++ [y]) =
      List.zipWith Nat.add xs ys ++ [x + y] := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil =>
      cases ys with
      | nil => simp
      | cons y ys => simp at hlen
  | cons a as ih =>
      cases ys with
      | nil => simp at hlen
      | cons b bs =>
          have htail : as.length = bs.length := by simpa using hlen
          simp [List.zipWith, ih bs htail]

theorem zipWith_add_terminal (xs ys : Word) (x y : Nat)
    (hlen : xs.length = ys.length) :
    (List.zipWith Nat.add (xs ++ [x]) (ys ++ [y])).getLast? =
      some (x + y) := by
  rw [zipWith_add_snoc xs ys x y hlen]
  simp

#print axioms zipWith_add_snoc
#print axioms zipWith_add_terminal
end Agent110.TwoStepZip

# Agent #110 | Actual exterior two-step return investigation (WIP)

**Claim:** agent110-exterior-two-step-return-20261016, coordinated in https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/issues/61. Source baseline: historical Agent6 ExteriorCore.lean and ExteriorCoverage.lean at commit e775dd342df5190643a61595ff8d93dabfe98a69. Authenticated GitHub account taco-jpg is NOT a dedicated agent identity.

**Precise target:** prove for every canonical P196.Agent6.Exterior state s with phase=6 that advance(advance s) != s, or construct and verify a true counterexample. The phase 6→12→6 is the only possible two-step phase loop of the canonical even nonneutral phases. All finite word lengths are in scope, with the empty word and singleton handled separately.

**Verification status:** This is written proof development and exact exploratory computation only. BoundaryArithmetic.lean has NOT been compiled or axiom audited. No final all-width Lean result, complete palindrome-avoidance result, new integer orbit or infinite 196 theorem is claimed. Do not put source in any accepted build yet.

## Concrete results

- reference_scan.py is a literal independent Python port of original norm, trim, advance and Canonical, validated against the six-state historical Agent110 radial-observable witness. Exhaustive phase6 canonical widths 0..5 yielded counts [1,17,324,6156,116964,2222316], **2,345,778 distinct states** total, zero exact two-step state returns. Full width histogram in scan-length-0-to-5.log. This proves nothing about all widths.
- boundary_obstruction.py checks all necessary terminal-column digit/carry constraints for a putative two-step return, permitting arbitrary digits of the unknown interior reflected normalizations. It finds zero candidate tuples over 3 choices of first trim, 2*2 overflow bits, x and w in 0..18, and both incoming carries in 0..1. This finite abstraction is width-independent but only gives an all-width theorem when the exact source-to-abstraction bridge is proved in Lean.
- BoundaryArithmetic.lean defines the same abstract finite predicate with an intended pure kernel decide theorem, isolated as uncompiled WIP. No native_decide, new axiom, sorry or admitted proof is used.
- An exploratory fixed-width mixed-integer model including full 0/1 carries and actual trim/width constraints found solver-infeasible cases for every width 1..40 and spot widths 50,100,200,400, across all 12 branches. This is **not** an UNSAT proof certificate and requires no acceptance inference.

## Width-independent terminal-column derivation (written candidate, not yet Lean verified)

Let B be a canonical phase6 word with n>=2, x its terminal coefficient (0<=x<=18, x!=6), a in {0,1} the forward carry entering x, and mu in {0,1} its reflected overflow bit. Since raw output length of each advance is old word length plus one, a true two-step equality implies **q+r=2**, where q is first trim count and r second trim count. Thus q is exactly 0,1,2. Set lam1=floor((x+a)/10), e=x%10. The last raw coefficient L1 equals 12+lam1 if mu=0, or 6+lam1+e if mu=1. The penultimate raw coefficient P1 is (x+a)%10+x%10 if mu=0, or (x+a)%10+d with a free reflected digit 0<=d<=9 if mu=1.

If q=0, the final surviving first-step coefficient is w=L1 !=12. If q=1, L1=12, w=P1 !=12. If q=2, L1=P1=12, and w is some 0..18 coefficient !=12.

For phase12 set b in {0,1} for incoming forward carry into w, nu in {0,1} for reflected overflow, lam2=floor((w+b)/10). The second raw final coefficient L2 equals 5+lam2 if nu=0, or 2+lam2+(w+1)%10 if nu=1. Its penultimate raw coefficient P2 equals (w+b)%10+(w+1)%10 if nu=0, or (w+b)%10+f for a free 0<=f<=9 if nu=1.

If q=0 then r=2 entails L2=P2=6; if q=1 then r=1 entails L2=6 and P2=x; if q=2 then r=0 entails L2=x. These necessary conditions are inconsistent, as checked by exhaustive finite arithmetic.

Manual case audit:
- q=0, mu=0: no first trim implies lam1=1, hence w=13. With nu=0, P2=7+b>6; with nu=1, L2=7.
- q=0, mu=1: w>=6 and w!=12. For nu=1, L2=6 would require w=3 or 12, impossible. For nu=0, L2=P2=6 would require w=12, impossible.
- q=1, mu=0: L1=12 implies x+a<=9 and w=2x+a !=12. If nu=0, equality of P2=x gives 3x+2a+b=19; its only solution with a,b in {0,1} is (x,a,b)=(6,0,1), excluded by canonicality. If nu=1, L2=6 implies w=3 (w12 excluded), giving x=1,a=1 but P2>=3>x.
- q=1, mu=1: L1=12 forces x=15 (alternative x=6 excluded), and w lies between 5 and 15 inclusive, w!=12. With nu=0, P2<=12<x; with nu=1, L2=6 forces w=3 or 12.
- q=2, mu=0: L1=P1=12 would force x=6 (excluded). For mu=1 it forces x=15, whereas the untrimmed second L2<=12.
- Boundary cases n=0 and n=1 checked by Python exact enumeration, but NOT by Lean; require separate kernel checks.

## Formalization obligations

(1) Prove terminal-digit/terminal-carry extraction from the *original* norm and both reflected normalizations. (2) Prove raw width = prior width +1, exact prefix/suffix trimming, and bound all new coefficients by 18 for the relevant canonical inputs. (3) Extract q,r and the abstract witness from actual equality of two exteriors; in particular n>=2 allows a penultimate raw coefficient, and q+r=2. (4) Rebuild the finite arithmetic kernel with Lean 4.19.0 and #print axioms; then prove the imported original-map two-cycle exclusion. (5) Kernel-check n=0 and1. Review exact semantics and hypothesis preservation independently before accepting any theorem.

The known Agent9 ExteriorErasure full_binary_collapse has arbitrarily deep one-step contractions for specific words, so width monotonicity must NOT be assumed. The existing historical Agent110 radion/phase observable returns without actual state return; the old result is preserved and not duplicated. The current scope does not take Agent #6 signed-beta update/telescope, Agent #416 return-certificate lower bounds, or any shared main-branch integration slot.

import ExteriorCapTwo

namespace P196.Agent6

@[simp] theorem trim_append_phase (c : Nat) (w : Word) :
    trim c (w ++ [c]) = trim c w := by
  simp [trim, List.reverse_append]

@[simp] theorem trim_phase_pair (c : Nat) : trim c [c,c] = [] := by
  simp [trim]

/-- Structural assumptions on a canonical periodic exterior. -/
def Canonical (s : Exterior) : Prop :=
  0 < s.phase ∧ s.phase ≤ 16 ∧ s.phase % 2 = 0 ∧
  (∀ x ∈ s.word, x ≤ 18) ∧
  (∀ x xs, s.word = x :: xs → 0 < x) ∧
  trim s.phase s.word = s.word

/-- Every canonical cap-two exterior is represented by the checked decoder. -/
theorem capTwo_coverage (s : Exterior) (hs : Canonical s)
    (hlen : s.word.length ≤ 2) :
    ∃ i j z, i < 8 ∧ j < 18 ∧ z < 19 ∧ s = decode 1 i j z := by
  rcases s with ⟨c,w⟩
  rcases hs with ⟨hpos,hmax,heven,hcoeff,hhead,htrim⟩
  dsimp only at hpos hmax heven hcoeff hhead htrim hlen
  have hi : c / 2 - 1 < 8 := by omega
  have hc : 2 * (c / 2 - 1 + 1) = c := by omega
  cases w with
  | nil =>
      refine ⟨c/2-1,c-1,c,hi,by omega,by omega,?_⟩
      have hm : c % 19 = c := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
      simp [decode,digits19,hc,hm,show c-1+1=c by omega]
  | cons x xs =>
      have hxpos : 0 < x := hhead x xs rfl
      have hxmax : x ≤ 18 := hcoeff x (by simp)
      cases xs with
      | nil =>
          refine ⟨c/2-1,x-1,c,hi,by omega,by omega,?_⟩
          have hm : c % 19 = c := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
          simp only [decode,digits19,hc,hm,show x-1+1=x by omega]
          congr 1
          change [x] = trim c ([x] ++ [c])
          rw [trim_append_phase, htrim]
      | cons y ys =>
          have hymax : y ≤ 18 := hcoeff y (by simp)
          have hys : ys = [] := by
            have : ys.length = 0 := by simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen; omega
            exact List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp this
          subst ys
          refine ⟨c/2-1,x-1,y,hi,by omega,by omega,?_⟩
          have hm : y % 19 = y := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
          simp [decode,digits19,hc,hm,show x-1+1=x by omega,htrim]

/-- Unconditional finite certificate for all canonical exteriors of length <=2. -/
theorem capTwo_uniform_escape (s : Exterior) (hs : Canonical s)
    (hlen : s.word.length ≤ 2) :
    ∃ t, t ≤ 7 ∧ 2 < (iterate t s).word.length := by
  obtain ⟨i,j,z,hi,hj,hz,heq⟩ := capTwo_coverage s hs hlen
  subst s
  exact capTwo_escape i j z hi hj hz

/-- There is no seven-transition canonical path entirely inside cap two. -/
theorem capTwo_no_confined_path (s : Exterior) (hs : Canonical s)
    (hpath : ∀ t, t ≤ 7 → (iterate t s).word.length ≤ 2) : False := by
  have hlen : s.word.length ≤ 2 := hpath 0 (by omega)
  obtain ⟨t,ht,he⟩ := capTwo_uniform_escape s hs hlen
  have hb := hpath t ht
  omega

#print axioms trim_append_phase
#print axioms trim_phase_pair
#print axioms capTwo_coverage
#print axioms capTwo_uniform_escape
#print axioms capTwo_no_confined_path
end P196.Agent6

@[simp] theorem trim_append_phase (c : Nat) (w : Word) :
    trim c (w ++ [c]) = trim c w := by
  simp [trim, List.reverse_append]

@[simp] theorem trim_phase_pair (c : Nat) : trim c [c,c] = [] := by
  simp [trim]

/-- Structural assumptions on a canonical periodic exterior. -/
def Canonical (s : Exterior) : Prop :=
  0 < s.phase ∧ s.phase ≤ 16 ∧ s.phase % 2 = 0 ∧
  (∀ x ∈ s.word, x ≤ 18) ∧
  (∀ x xs, s.word = x :: xs → 0 < x) ∧
  trim s.phase s.word = s.word

/-- Every canonical cap-two exterior is represented by the checked decoder. -/
theorem capTwo_coverage (s : Exterior) (hs : Canonical s)
    (hlen : s.word.length ≤ 2) :
    ∃ i j z, i < 8 ∧ j < 18 ∧ z < 19 ∧ s = decode 1 i j z := by
  rcases s with ⟨c,w⟩
  rcases hs with ⟨hpos,hmax,heven,hcoeff,hhead,htrim⟩
  dsimp only at hpos hmax heven hcoeff hhead htrim hlen
  have hi : c / 2 - 1 < 8 := by omega
  have hc : 2 * (c / 2 - 1 + 1) = c := by omega
  cases w with
  | nil =>
      refine ⟨c/2-1,c-1,c,hi,by omega,by omega,?_⟩
      have hm : c % 19 = c := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
      simp [decode,digits19,hc,hm,show c-1+1=c by omega]
  | cons x xs =>
      have hxpos : 0 < x := hhead x xs rfl
      have hxmax : x ≤ 18 := hcoeff x (by simp)
      cases xs with
      | nil =>
          refine ⟨c/2-1,x-1,c,hi,by omega,by omega,?_⟩
          have hm : c % 19 = c := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
          simp only [decode,digits19,hc,hm,show x-1+1=x by omega]
          congr 1
          change [x] = trim c ([x] ++ [c])
          rw [trim_append_phase, htrim]
      | cons y ys =>
          have hymax : y ≤ 18 := hcoeff y (by simp)
          have hys : ys = [] := by
            have : ys.length = 0 := by simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen; omega
            exact List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp this
          subst ys
          refine ⟨c/2-1,x-1,y,hi,by omega,by omega,?_⟩
          have hm : y % 19 = y := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
          simp [decode,digits19,hc,hm,show x-1+1=x by omega,htrim]

/-- Unconditional finite certificate for all canonical exteriors of length <=2. -/
theorem capTwo_uniform_escape (s : Exterior) (hs : Canonical s)
    (hlen : s.word.length ≤ 2) :
    ∃ t, t ≤ 7 ∧ 2 < (iterate t s).word.length := by
  obtain ⟨i,j,z,hi,hj,hz,heq⟩ := capTwo_coverage s hs hlen
  subst s
  exact capTwo_escape i j z hi hj hz

/-- There is no seven-transition canonical path entirely inside cap two. -/
theorem capTwo_no_confined_path (s : Exterior) (hs : Canonical s)
    (hpath : ∀ t, t ≤ 7 → (iterate t s).word.length ≤ 2) : False := by
  have hlen : s.word.length ≤ 2 := hpath 0 (by omega)
  obtain ⟨t,ht,he⟩ := capTwo_uniform_escape s hs hlen
  have hb := hpath t ht
  omega
